name: DOOM: The Dark Ages
native_kbm_note: No source says the PS5 version supports keyboard/mouse for gameplay, and it is not on Push Square's PS5 mouse+keyboard games list (pushsquare.com/guides/all-ps5-ps4-games-with-mouse-and-keyboard-support).
notes: Slayer on-foot bindings only. Mech (Atlan) and dragon use the same PC keys for different PS5 buttons, so one profile can't cover them: Atlan dash is PC Space vs PS5 L2, and Atlan finisher is RMB vs R1. On the dragon, PC E/Q ascend/descend maps to PS5 R1/L1, Space dodge to Circle, LCTRL ability to R3 and RMB assault mode to L2. Shield bash is RMB held + LMB (L2 held + R2), which works automatically. PC weapon keys 1-6 have no PS5 equivalent (use R1 quick-switch). Game8 lists Touchpad = Pause and Options = Dossier, but MagicGameWorld and id's usual layout say Options = pause and Touchpad = dossier; this file uses the latter.
